# Arvato

Arvato is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Arvato is a logistics provider for e-commerce and B2B, offering 3PL fulfillment, B2B fulfillment, e-commerce fulfillment, omnichannel fulfillment, warehousing, transportation management, reverse logistics, customer service, financial services, order-to-cash, digital solutions, and customer experience platform (CXC). Arvato employs 13,105 people (+9.1% YoY, +1097 people) and has an annual revenue of EUR4.2B. Headquartered in Gütersloh, Germany, operates in 17 countries (including United States, Poland, France, United Kingdom, and China). Its workforce is distributed across 52 countries (including Germany, United States, Netherlands, Poland, and Turkey).

## About

Logistics may sound simple. Goods in, goods out. In reality, it is a key driver of growth, resilience and customer experience.

Arvato is a global 3PL service provider specializing in supply chain management and e-commerce. We enable global companies to bring their supply chain strategies into high-performing operations that are fast, precise and reliable.

By combining deep industry expertise with advanced technologies, we design and operate complex distribution and fulfillment networks tailored to our clients’ needs. Across Consumer Products, Tech, Healthcare, Automotive and Publishing, we create supply chains that go beyond delivery and actively strengthen our clients’ market position.

Our teams bring this to life every day. Across more than 100 locations worldwide, over 20,000 employees work with a strong focus on technology, data and operational excellence to deliver resilient performance and adapt quickly to changing business needs. They are all connected by a shared mindset that is collaborative, hands-on and always moving forward.

Our solutions are built to scale, designed for sustainability and ready for what comes next.

# Arvato Systems

Arvato Systems is a IT Services and IT Consulting company. Arvato Systems is an internationally active IT specialist and multi-cloud service provider that supports companies in their digital transformation. Arvato Systems employs 2,998 people (-2.1% YoY, -65 people) and has an annual revenue of $430M. Headquartered in Gütersloh, Nordrhein-Westfalen, Germany, with presence in United States. Its workforce is distributed across 26 countries (including Germany, China, United States, Romania, and Spain).

## About

We are Arvato Systems - and we live digitalization. As an international IT specialist, we support companies on their journey into the digital future - with expertise and real team spirit. Whether cloud, IT operations, or process integration: together with our customers, we develop innovative solutions that make a difference. What makes us special? Our in-depth understanding of the industry, strong technical expertise, and clear focus on our customers' needs. We listen, think, and act with foresight - always to make the digital world simpler, more efficient, and more secure. As part of Bertelsmann, we stand on the solid foundation of a German global corporation - and are building the digital world of tomorrow together with strong partners such as AWS, Google, Microsoft, and SAP.

properties.description:
We are Arvato Systems - and we live digitalization. As an international IT specialist, we support companies on their journey into the digital future - with expertise and real team spirit. Whether cloud, IT operations, or process integration: together with our customers, we develop innovative solutions that make a difference. What makes us special? Our in-depth understanding of the industry, strong technical expertise, and clear focus on our customers' needs. We listen, think, and act with foresight - always to make the digital world simpler, more efficient, and more secure. As part of Bertelsmann, we stand on the solid foundation of a German global corporation - and are building the digital world of tomorrow together with strong partners such as AWS, Google, Microsoft, and SAP. 

Follow us to learn more about digital transformation - and how we can shape it together.
